text: I am sorry, there is, there is nothing there. The ledger doesn't lie. I checked.
I can't give you what isn't there. I would, believe me, I would.
The bank is closed. Rules are rules. Even now. Especially now.
Deposited. One per cent a round, compounded. It is, it is a very good rate, under the circumstances.
Into the safe it goes. Into the safe. Nobody touches the safe.
Received with thanks. I am writing it in the ledger. My hand is shaking, but it is in the ledger.
Very good. Your money is safer than either of us.
Oh! Oh, thank God, a customer. A living one. The, the bank is open. We are always open. Herr Direktor said so.
Please don't let them in. I mean, good evening. Welcome to the Darlehenskasse. How may I help you?
I locked the door, but there is no door anymore. Deposits? Withdrawals? Please be quick.
You again! I carried the cash box all the way up from the crossroads. Your account is safe. I am not.
Lohnbüro, pay office, bank, whatever this is now. Your savings came with me. Every pfennig, I counted twice.
Oh God. Oh God oh God. Don't look at me, don't look at me.
Here. Count it, please. I can't, my hands won't.
Withdrawal. Of course. Spend it on bullets, please. Lots of bullets.
Your money, sir. Please come back. Please come back alive.
They're here, they're right here! Do something!
I'm only the junior clerk! I'm only the junior clerk!
Shoot it, shoot it, please shoot it!
